title: Global Convergence of Multiplicative Updates for the Matrix Mechanism: A Collaborative Proof with Gemini 3
summary: We analyze a fixed-point iteration $v \leftarrow φ(v)$ arising in the optimization of a regularized nuclear norm objective involving the Hadamard product structure, posed in DMR+22 in the context of an optimization problem over the space of algorithms in private machine learning. We prove that the iteration $v^{(k+1)} = \text{diag}((D_{v^{(k)}}^{1/2} M D_{v^{(k)}}^{1/2})^{1/2})$ converges monotonically to the unique global optimizer of the potential function $J(v) = 2 \text{Tr}((D_v^{1/2} M D_v^{1/2})^{1/2}) - \sum v_i$, closing a problem left open there.
